clue.text: It's super being one in crashing dodgem

indicators.note: the Roman numeral for one is placed inside the rearranged letters
dodgems are bumper cars that crash, so the letters of the word are knocked into a new order

parts.note: the Roman numeral I stands for one

explanation.surface: Someone at the fairground is having a super time in a bumper car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crashing' turns DODGEM into DEMGOD, and 'in' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A half-god, more than mortal, is a superhuman being.

clue.text: Deny pig involved in racket

indicators.note: one word is wrapped up inside the other, as something involved in a business is part of it

parts.note: a din is a loud racket
a sow is a female pig

explanation.surface: Someone refuses to admit any pig was mixed up in a shady scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'racket' looks like a scam; here it is noise.
explanation.definitionFit: To repudiate or refuse to acknowledge something is to deny it.

clue.text: Plant rocked by Maoism

indicators.note: something rocked is shaken up, so the letters of the following word are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A political plant is shaken by Chinese communist ideology.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrub or tree of the pea family with fluffy yellow flowers is a plant.

clue.text: Group scrutinising stars eating fine food

parts.note: G is a standard abbreviation for group
the study of stars and the heavens is astronomy

explanation.surface: A team of stargazers tucks into a gourmet meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eating' seems to signal one piece going inside another, but it belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The art and practice of good eating, enjoying fine cuisine, is this word's sense.

clue.text: Risked getting cut up

definitions.meaning: chopped into small cubes, as vegetables are

explanation.surface: Someone took a chance and ended up hurt.
explanation.definitionFit: Playing dice is gambling, and cooks cut food into small cubes.

clue.text: Carnivore spotted fat American writer turning in

indicators.note: the turned writer's name is placed inside the word for fat

parts.note: lard is pig fat

indicators.note: turning means the writer's name is read backwards

parts.note: Edgar Allan Poe was an American writer

explanation.surface: A fat American writer is seen turning in for the night.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Carnivore spotted' as 'spotted carnivore'; 'turning in' looks like going to bed but splits into two signals.
explanation.definitionFit: The big cat with a dappled coat is a meat-eater famous for its spots.

clue.text: Fish for Lunar Excursion Module control panel when failing to start

parts.note: the Apollo landing craft was known as the LEM

indicators.note: the word loses its opening letter, as a thing failing to start lacks its beginning

parts.note: a console is a control panel

explanation.surface: An Apollo lander's control panel fails as it tries to start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when failing to start' drops the C, leaving ONSOLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A European flatfish prized for eating is one kind of fish.

clue.text: Female spurns West for Middle Eastern country

indicators.note: to spurn is to reject, so the letter for West is thrown out

parts.note: a woman is a female

explanation.surface: A woman turns her back on the West for life in the Middle East.
explanation.definitionFit: A sultanate on the Arabian peninsula is a Middle Eastern nation.

clue.text: A nasty fall in a ditch round Channel Islands

indicators.note: the letters for the islands are placed with the ditch phrase going round them

parts.note: a drain is a ditch
CI is the abbreviation for the Channel Islands, Jersey, Guernsey and others

explanation.surface: Someone takes a bad tumble into a ditch near the Channel Islands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fall' looks like a tumble; here it is rainfall.
explanation.definitionFit: Polluted precipitation is a harmful kind of rainfall, a nasty fall from the sky.

clue.text: Grades foremost of equestrian sportsmen performing in this?

definitions.text: Grades foremost of equestrian sportsmen performing in this?

indicators.note: performing means putting on a show, so the letters are worked into a new routine
the first letters of the next two words are taken

explanation.surface: Riders are graded on how they perform in a horse-training event.
explanation.walkthrough: GRADES plus E and S, from 'foremost of', rearranged by 'performing'.
explanation.definitionFit: Horse and rider are graded in this equestrian discipline of precise trained movements.

clue.text: Saint takes biblical book on Greek island

parts.note: Amos is a book of the Old Testament

explanation.surface: A saint carries a book of the Bible onto a Greek island.
explanation.definitionFit: An Aegean isle, birthplace of Pythagoras, lies in Greece.

clue.text: Bell tower affected imbecile

parts.note: camp means theatrical, affected
anile means senile, feeble-minded like an old woman

explanation.surface: A bell tower is described as a pretentious fool.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian word for a free-standing tower housing bells.

clue.text: Partners going through paces for county once

parts.note: in bridge West and East play as partners
striding is walking with long paces

explanation.surface: Two partners walk together through their steps.
explanation.walkthrough: Yorkshire was divided into three ridings until 1974.
explanation.definitionFit: This was a former administrative division of Yorkshire, a county-like area now abolished.

clue.text: Flag intermittently in air raids

indicators.note: intermittently means at intervals, so every other letter of the words is taken

explanation.surface: A flag flies now and then during bombing raids.
explanation.definitionFit: Yellow flag is a wild species of this flower, so flag names the plant.

clue.text: Expert sportsman with desire keeping going

parts.note: a pro is a professional, expert sportsman
longing is a strong desire

explanation.surface: A professional athlete's ambition keeps them going.
explanation.definitionFit: Extending something in time means continuing it, keeping it going.

clue.text: Is presently going on the wagon perhaps for winter sport

parts.note: is shortens to 's, as in it's
presently means now, at present
boarding is getting on a vehicle, such as a railway wagon

explanation.surface: Someone is giving up drink for the cold season.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the wagon' looks like teetotal; here it is literally climbing aboard.
explanation.definitionFit: Riding a single board down snowy slopes is a sport of the cold months.

clue.text: With tight elastic mostly that's held in!

definitions.text: With tight elastic mostly that's held in!

indicators.note: tight means drunk, so the letters stagger into a new order
the word loses its last letter, leaving most of it

explanation.surface: A tight elastic band keeps the stomach held in.
explanation.walkthrough: W plus ELASTI (elastic without C, from 'mostly') plus IN are rearranged by 'tight'.
explanation.definitionFit: The middle of the body is what a tight elastic belt holds in.

clue.text: Son robbed in street picked up pounds and ran

indicators.note: the word for robbed has picked up the letter for pounds and holds it inside

parts.note: mugged means robbed in the street
L is the abbreviation for pounds sterling, from libra

explanation.surface: A son is robbed in the street, picks up some money and runs off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ran' looks like moved fast; here it means brought in contraband, as in gun-running.
explanation.definitionFit: To run goods is to bring them in illegally, as contraband.

clue.text: I put off besotted admirer

parts.note: to put off a task is to do it later

explanation.surface: Someone is put off by an infatuated fan.
explanation.definitionFit: A worshipper of an idol, or anyone excessively devoted, is a besotted admirer.

clue.text: Miss French cheese sent back with wine I consumed

indicators.note: the cheese's name is sent back, read in reverse

parts.note: Edam is a Dutch cheese

indicators.note: the wine has consumed the letter, holding it inside

parts.note: Moselle is a German wine

explanation.surface: A French woman sends back the cheese and drinks wine instead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sent back' reverses EDAM to MADE; 'consumed' puts I into MOSELLE.
explanation.definitionFit: The French title for an unmarried woman, equivalent to Miss in English.

clue.text: Musical setting for 'Mamma Mia' as spoken

indicators.note: as spoken signals that the setting's name is said out loud for a word of the same sound

parts.note: the film Mamma Mia is set on a Greek island, so its setting is Greece

explanation.surface: Where the musical Mamma Mia takes place, as one might say.
explanation.definitionFit: A 1970s stage show and film starring Travolta in the film is a musical.

clue.text: Turn one's attention to publicity

definitions.meaning: to refer or direct attention to something

explanation.surface: Someone redirects their focus to marketing.
explanation.definitionFit: Its verb sense means refer, and its noun is short for advertisement.

clue.text: Swallow to stop coming back

indicators.note: coming back means the word for stopping is read backwards

parts.note: to plug is to stop up a hole

explanation.surface: A swallow stops on its return migration.
explanation.definitionFit: A big gulp of food or drink is a swallow, the noun or verb.

clue.text: Daring breakout freeing last pair from PoW camp in WWII conflict

indicators.note: a breakout scatters the prisoners, so the letters break into a new arrangement
the final two letters are released from the camp's name

parts.note: a Stalag was a German prisoner-of-war camp

explanation.surface: A daring escape from a prisoner-of-war camp in the Second World War.
explanation.walkthrough: 'freeing last pair from' cuts STALAG to STAL; 'breakout' mixes it with DARING.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1942-43 siege on the Volga was a decisive battle of the Second World War.

clue.text: Fortune placed on American car

parts.note: one's lot is one's fortune or fate

explanation.surface: A fortune is spent on an American car.
explanation.definitionFit: A British sports car maker, so a model of theirs is a car.

clue.text: Refuse one lacking in intellect

indicators.note: the word for intellect is lacking the letter for one

parts.note: brain means intellect
the Roman numeral I stands for one

explanation.surface: Someone without much intelligence is turned away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' looks like a verb; it is the noun meaning waste.
explanation.definitionFit: Husks sifted from flour are the waste, the leftover chaff of milling.

clue.text: See religious leader stir guilt terribly

indicators.note: terribly suggests something badly done, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A cleric is seen rousing feelings of guilt in a congregation.
explanation.definitionFit: An expert in or leader of liturgy, the forms of public worship, is a religious figure.

clue.text: Picture that is providing cover for periodical

indicators.note: the outer letters cover, or surround, the periodical

parts.note: i.e. abbreviates id est, that is
a mag is a magazine, a periodical

explanation.surface: A picture serves as the cover for a magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: A visual representation or likeness is a picture.

clue.text: Drive mad, eccentric grandee

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, so the letters are put in an odd order

explanation.surface: An odd aristocrat drives someone round the bend.
explanation.definitionFit: To unhinge or make insane is to drive someone mad.

clue.text: Section of federal agents in in-group

indicators.note: the agents are placed inside the word for the group

parts.note: a set is a social circle or clique
G-men are FBI agents, government men

explanation.surface: A unit of FBI agents operates within a clique.
explanation.definitionFit: A part or portion cut off from a whole is a section.
